content.comment_body: This file from 2022 now shows an error stating it isn't a LAD diagram. I can't recall which version of [product_name] was used previously, but currently I'm using version [version_no]. Is this issue related to software version compatibility, or is the file corrupted? I need access to this file—are there alternative methods to open it?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Without more details about your situation and the specific program file, it is difficult for anyone to give you accurate assistance. Even as a new forum member, please follow proper etiquette. Best regards, [user_name]
Could you please upload your program as a ZIP archive?
I have uploaded the requested file.
What kind of detailed description is needed?

This situation appears as follows: The file isn't recognized as an lld file and contains no data. I’ve included two screenshots from a HEX editor—one from your file, which shows only zero values, and one from my working file.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to open an older project file using [product_name] at version [version_no], receiving an error that the file isn't a LAD diagram. Upon closer examination, the file is found to be entirely empty, likely corrupted, and it cannot be accessed or restored with the current software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that projects created in earlier software versions will remain compatible and accessible in newer releases. Additionally, the user is looking for ways to recover or open a file that may be damaged or incompatible.
